review.tagline: Obsidian plugin that runs coding agents like Claude Code in your vault
review.summary: Claudian is an Obsidian plugin that embeds CLI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi, DeepSeek Harness) in a sidebar chat, using the vault as the working directory. Agents can read, write, edit, search and run commands on vault files. It adds inline edit with diff preview, slash commands and skills, @mentions, MCP via each CLI's config, and cross-session messaging.
review.audience: Obsidian users who want terminal coding agents working on their vault
strengths: Supports six agent harnesses behind one UI, with models discovered from each provider
Inline edit shows word-level diffs on selected text or at the cursor
No telemetry; network use limited to provider calls, MCP endpoints and a 127.0.0.1 listener
Agents can message, steer or start other sessions on any provider
weaknesses: Requires at least one separately installed agent CLI plus a subscription or API provider
Desktop only; needs Obsidian 1.13.0 or newer
Pull requests that add new providers are not accepted
CLI detection can fail when Obsidian is launched from the Dock; needs PATH or env workarounds
needs: Needs Obsidian 1.13.0+, Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi or DeepSeek Harness CLI, Subscription or API provider
Models: Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, Pi
